thread:
sara: Hey — noticed the dashboard p50/p95 numbers don't match when I drill down by endpoint. p50 on the top-level is ~120ms but endpoint 'chat.generate' shows p50 85ms. anyone else seen this?
ali: Yup saw that earlier. I suspected different aggregation windows or sample sources. top-level uses the rollup t-digest, endpoint panel queries raw logs.
jamie: Confirming — we have two ingestion paths. live-collector -> raw-logs (kept 7d) and rollup-service that emits t-digests every minute. They use different sampling: rollup applies weighted sampling by route weight.
devon: That would explain mismatch. Rollup's sampling can bias medians if a high-latency route is over-weighted in the rollup. Also route tagging wasn't always present for fallback routing variants.
sara: Ah, fallback routing — for capacity shortages we route to model-variant B which adds ~60ms. If rollup attributes those requests to the default route due to missing tag, p50 at service-level inflates.
ali: We should verify which panels use which source. The top-level latency card (Dashboard: Overview -> P50/P95/P99) is wired to rollup:t_digest_agg, while the endpoint breakdown uses query: logs -> compute percentiles on raw latency_ms.
jamie: Quick log query I ran:
```
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) AS p50, percentile_cont(0.95) AS p95
FROM raw_requests
WHERE route = 'chat.generate' AND ts >= now() - interval '1 hour';
```
Rollup side uses compressed t-digest metadata: `tdigest_merge(agg)` with decaying window.
sara: Two issues to address: 1) inconsistent source labeling in the UI, 2) missing routing_variant tag on some fallbacks. Also need to surface that rollup uses weighted sampling + decay.
devon: Proposal: change dashboard legend to show "p50 (rollup)" vs "p50 (raw logs)" and add tooltip: "computed from aggregated t-digests (1m buckets, weighted sampling, decaying window)". Also add a warning icon when an endpoint has >5% requests missing routing_variant tag.
ali: Ops note — adding tooltip is low-risk. Tagging fix requires a deploy: collector should always carry `routing_variant` from router. I'll take owner for collector change (ali).
jamie: I'll update the dashboard panels and add a small help doc explaining differences and include a link to an example query. I can also add an explainer for why p95/p99 diverge more than p50 when sampling differs.
sara: Sounds good. Can we also add a temporary quick filter on the dashboard to switch data-source (rollup vs raw) so SREs can compare quickly?
devon: Yeah, add a dropdown in console for data_source {rollup, raw_logs}. Jamie, can you estimate effort?
jamie: ETA: tooltip + legend change ~1d. data_source dropdown + panel wiring ~2d. I can do the dashboard changes tomorrow.
ali: Collector change: small change to include routing_variant header -> tag mapping; will need a canary deploy. I'll PR today.
sara: Great. For tracking: create a short RFC? or just a ticket?
jamie: I'll file a ticket (ENGPL-3245) with acceptance: dashboard shows data-source switch, legend updated, and raw vs rollup docs. I'll link ali's PR and devon will add the missing-tag alert.
console-bot: Ticket ENGPL-3245 created by jamie: "Dashboard: clarify percentile data sources and fix routing_variant tagging". Assigned: jamie, ali, devon. Priority: P2.
sara: Thanks all :thumbsup: Let's meet 10:30 if any blockers after initial changes.
